title: Oferă tot ce ai nevoie!

title: Good app but widgets are not working
body: I really like the functionality of the app but the widgets are just not working well. Even if i select a folder, the bad habits are not going to be shown. Also, for the good habits, a lot of times a device restart is needed because the widgets are going blank. It’s really annoying for a habit tracker to have issues with the widgets.
